svg.aria-label: Anmol Sethi, filled in like an OMR sheet. Applying for Product Ops, APM or PM roles. Based in Gurugram. B.Tech ENC, Thapar Institute, 2027. Can join immediately. I ran operations and data at MathonGo, an edtech platform, where the exam analysis pipelines I built reached 500K+ JEE students. Now I build tools for data that has to be right, like a live map of every startup hiring in Delhi NCR.
